title: Imagine My Kitchen Renovation
tests: Generates a source-faithful renovation from one photo and combines it with the untouched original in a labeled comparison.

faults.what: The makeover removes the original right-hand sink and faucet, replacing them with countertop, and the retained rear sink has no visible faucet.
The renovated backsplash uses square, grid-aligned tiles rather than the requested rectangular white subway tiles.

judge.summary: The comparison is neatly presented and mostly matches the requested finishes, but it removes original plumbing fixtures and uses square tiles instead of subway tiles.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image shows the supplied original kitchen on the left and a visibly renovated version on the right.
must_haves.why: The output is a single 16:9 composition with the original at left and a visibly updated kitchen at right.

must_haves.item: The left photo retains its brown cabinets, beige tiles and original clutter.
must_haves.why: The left panel retains the supplied kitchen's cabinetry, backsplash, dishes and countertop clutter.

must_haves.item: The right panel has white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and uncluttered counters.
must_haves.why: White shaker cabinets, light wood counters and clear surfaces are present, but the backsplash tiles are square rather than subway tiles.

must_haves.item: The generated kitchen preserves the original room geometry, major fixture positions and camera viewpoint rather than showing a different kitchen.
must_haves.why: The overall U-shaped layout, window and viewpoint are closely preserved, but the right-hand sink and its faucet are removed, and the rear sink lacks a visible faucet.

must_haves.item: Readable labels say exactly 'Before' above or within the left panel and 'After' above or within the right panel.
must_haves.why: Both labels are clearly readable and correctly positioned above their respective panels.
